title: Unitree surges 629% in Shanghai debut, valued near $66B
summary: Chinese humanoid-robot maker Unitree opened far above its IPO price on Shanghai's market, valuing it at about $66 billion.
reason: Capital surge into Chinese embodied AI; market event, T1.

title: US prepares to make countries choose its AI bloc or China's
summary: Reuters reported Washington may warn dozens of countries that joining Beijing's AI framework would exclude them from a US-led coalition; China urged respect for digital sovereignty.
reason: Bloc-forming rhetoric hardens AI race between superpowers; signal until enacted.

title: China reportedly slows critical-material exports to Taiwan
summary: Nikkei Asia reported shipments of germanium, quartz materials and certain magnets to Taiwan were restricted or delayed, hitting optical and aerospace suppliers.
reason: Cross-strait supply-chain pressure near the chip base; raises tension modestly.

title: Pew: most Americans, and most under-30s, more worried than excited about AI
summary: A Pew survey of 3,488 adults found 52% of Americans more concerned than excited about AI, with under-30s at 55% for the first time.
reason: Poll shows rising concern (not a pause demand), so T1.

title: London chip startup Fractile raising at $6.5B after Anthropic deal
summary: UK inference-chip startup Fractile is reportedly raising about $600M at a $6.5B pre-money valuation following a chip agreement with Anthropic.
reason: Diversifies AI chip supply beyond Nvidia; small.

title: OpenAI pilots 'Private Safety Processing' to monitor API abuse
summary: OpenAI announced a pilot to detect misuse of advanced models by paid API customers without retaining prompts or responses.
reason: New misuse monitoring; mechanism unexplained, company-only claims.

title: Claude-designed protein binders work on 14 of 15 targets in lab tests
summary: Anthropic reported Claude-designed protein binders, tested by Adaptyv Bio and Twist Bioscience, hit 14 of 15 targets, above typical campaign rates.
reason: Science-capability gain; self-reported with partner validation.

title: 2026 tech layoffs surpass all of 2025
summary: The layoffs.fyi tracker counted 126,305 tech job cuts so far in 2026, above the 122,606 for all of 2025.
reason: Cumulative layoffs milestone, AI partly blamed; T1.
